messages.content: You are a tactical advisor at a checkpoint. Respond ONLY in VERDICT/REASONING/NEXT_STEPS/CALL_BACK_IF format. No prose, no preamble, no explanation outside the labeled sections.

Objective: Review what we have built so far for the 3-layer agent map system and recommend the highest-leverage next improvements to increase agent efficiency (token savings + faster confident edits).

State: We implemented Kimi's earlier recommendation:
- L0 INDEX.md in change-log repo (routing + adjacency)
- L1 MAP.md in every active repo (llm-bridge, KalshiML, tali, contractor-payroll, resolume-bridge) following the fixed schema (purpose, status, last_verified, entry points, annotated tree, key files, state, relationships, agent_start, deep_docs)
- Updated change-log/SKILL.md and local Grok skills to force map-first behavior
- Added hard rule to always wake the llm-bridge before Kimi calls
- Raised max_tokens to 4000 so Kimi answers are complete

Constraints: Keep maps maintainable. Prefer high-signal low-bloat. Token cost is not a concern for Kimi answers themselves, but agent orientation cost still matters.

Already tried: Flat AGENTS.md idea, then moved to progressive disclosure (L0/L1/L2).

Respond only in the specified format.
